passive.name: Carapace Wall
passive.description: When Coralus's HP is above 50%, reduces all incoming damage by 15% for itself and all allies.

skill1.name: Aqua Pincer
skill1.description: Crushes target with twin water-infused claws dealing 180% DMG and reducing enemy DEF by 25% for 2 turns.

skill2.name: Bubble Fortress
skill2.description: Creates a durable water barrier absorbing damage for the entire party lasting for 3 turns.

passive.name: Wildfire
passive.description: Attacks have a 35% chance to ignite enemies with Burn, dealing damage each round.

skill1.name: Flame Burst
skill1.description: Hurls an explosive fireball dealing 200% Fire DMG. Deals 350% DMG if target is Burned!

skill2.name: Inferno Eruption
skill2.description: Summons a raging vortex of foxfire hitting ALL enemies for 180% AoE Fire DMG.

passive.name: Enraged
passive.description: Gains +30% Base ATK bonus whenever Current HP drops below 50%.

skill1.name: Fire Claw
skill1.description: Executes a furious double strike, slashing the enemy twice for 85% ATK each.

skill2.name: Magma Impact
skill2.description: Slams molten magma onto the foe dealing 240% Fire DMG with guaranteed 30% Burn.

passive.name: Fluid Precision
passive.description: Basic Match-3 attacks recover 10% of Tidecrush Max HP as ocean tide vitality. If Tidecrush HP is full, gains 10 extra mana instead.

skill1.name: Frost Slash
skill1.description: Slices through enemy armor with dual frozen daggers dealing 175% Water DMG.

skill2.name: Tidal Surge
skill2.description: Converts all current Mana into bonus Attack stat (1 Mana = +0.2% Base ATK) lasting 3 turns with a 3-turn cooldown. Deals 0 direct damage!

passive.name: Wind Battery
passive.description: Gain 2 mana for every Wind or Electric orb consumed by either side.

skill1.name: Plasma Ray
skill1.description: Fires a concentrated beam of static electricity for 180% DMG and applies Silence.

skill2.name: Giga-Watt Explosion
skill2.description: Unleashes an overwhelming storm shockwave dealing 320% AoE Electric DMG with 1-turn Stun, sacrificing 30% of Glidron’s current HP.

passive.name: Static Surge
passive.description: Voltlynx attacks have +25% extra Critical Chance, and Voltlynx's critical attacks & abilities deal an extra 25% DMG.

skill1.name: Lightning Paw
skill1.description: Strikes with lightning agility dealing 110% Electric DMG with +25% bonus Critical Chance.

skill2.name: Thunder Bolt
skill2.description: Calls down 3 erratic lightning bolts hitting random enemies for 120% DMG each (each bolt randomly selects a target).

passive.name: Shatter Strike
passive.description: Ancient runes empower all physical and skill hits with +30% inherent Critical Chance.

skill1.name: Stone Crash
skill1.description: Gain Piercing for 2 turns, ignoring 50% of target DEF and still able to move this turn.

skill2.name: Tectonic Cleave
skill2.description: Ruptures the earth beneath opposing frontlines dealing a devastating 280% Earth DMG.

passive.name: Unyielding Granite
passive.description: Gains a Shield equal to 5% of max HP at the start of each round. Upon death, gives all allies a Shield equal to 25% of Stone Golem's max HP for 3 turns.

skill1.name: Stone Crash
skill1.description: Deals 120% Earth Physical Damage to a target enemy and has 30% chance to stun the Target.

skill2.name: Fortress Bulwark
skill2.description: Taunts all enemies for 2 turns, forcing them to target Stone Golem with single-target attacks and abilities. Instantly grants itself a Shield equal to 18% of its Max HP for 2 turns.

passive.name: Dewdrop Bloom
passive.description: Restores 8% Max HP to lowest ally each turn.

skill1.name: Hydro Cyclone
skill1.description: Deals 180% Water DMG and has 20% to give Frostbite to the target for 3 turns. If the target already has Frostbite, silent them for 1 turns.

skill2.name: Lotus Rain
skill2.description: Restores 160 HP to all allies and cleanses debuffs.

passive.name: Overclock Battery
passive.description: Charges +5 extra Mana whenever an Electric match is made.

skill1.name: Spark Matrix
skill1.description: Empowers team with +25% ATK for 2 rounds.

skill2.name: EMP Discharge
skill2.description: Blasts enemies with 210% AoE Electric & Metal DMG.

passive.name: Magma Shell
passive.description: Reflects 20% of incoming physical damage back as Fire Burn.

skill1.name: Lava Spurt
skill1.description: Shoots burning lava dealing 150% Fire DMG.

skill2.name: Volcanic Eruption
skill2.description: Rains molten slag and metallic debris dealing 230% AoE Fire & Steel damage.

passive.name: Absolute Zero
passive.description: Allies' Water and Wind skills have a 10% chance to give Frostbite (Reduce their Attack by 10%) to the enemies for 1 turn.

skill1.name: Crystal Scales
skill1.description: Scatters razor frost dealing 170% Wind DMG.

skill2.name: Blizzard Tempest
skill2.description: Summons a freezing blizzard tempest dealing 180% AoE Wind DMG.

passive.name: Static Feather
passive.description: Zapwing gains +10% ATK every time it takes damage from an attack or ability.

skill1.name: Lightning Beak
skill1.description: Zapwing coats its beak in concentrated electricity and dives into a single target, dealing 135% Electric Damage. Has a 35% chance to inflict stun to the target.

skill2.name: Thunder Gale Tempest
skill2.description: Flaps its wings rapidly to create a swirling storm of crackling lightning and gusting winds, dealing 220% Electric Damage to all enemies.

passive.name: Toxic Spore
passive.description: Whenever Vinedra executes an attack triggered by Earth orbs or casts an Active Skill, has a 35% chance to inflict Poison on the targeted enemy for 2 turns (DEF reduced by 10%, takes 5% max HP damage after its turn).

skill1.name: Thorn Whip
skill1.description: Vinedra lashes out with its thorny tail, dealing 70% Earth Damage. Gains +20% critical chance for attacks and abilities. If Vinedra has 25 or more mana remaining, it can use Thorn Whip again this turn!

skill2.name: Poisonous Burst
skill2.description: Opens the purple floral bulb on its tail to release a toxic cloud across the enemy side, dealing 85% Earth Damage to all foes with a 35% chance to poison each enemy.

passive.name: Tidal Momentum
passive.description: Gain a permanent Resonance effect. Bubbleboon doesn't lose a turn when using its abilities.
passive.effectDetail: Grants the Starmon an immediate continuation of action. Using an active ability does not consume the current turn's orb-switches, allowing the Starmon to continue moving orbs as if no skill was used in this step.

skill1.name: Double Jet Punch
skill1.description: Gain Double Strike for 1 turn. Bubbleboon performs consecutive orb switches instead of 1.

skill2.name: Bubble Bomb
skill2.description: Deals 180% Water Physical DMG to the target and converts 3 random non-water orbs into Water Orbs. If this conversion inadvertently triggers a chain of 3 or more connected Water orbs, it inflicts an additional burst of DMG equal to 100% Atk.

passive.name: Infiltration Strike
passive.description: Trojan Flare gains an additional 10% ATK (calculated from its base ATK) and Piercing whenever a Shield is currently active on it. This attack bonus immediately disappears when the shield expires or is broken.

skill1.name: Siege Charge
skill1.description: Gain Clarity (Immune to stun, froze bite, burn, poison) and Resonance effect for 1 turn (Resonance is applied in the next turn, not this).
skill1.effectDetail: Grants the Starmon an immediate continuation of action. Using an active ability does not consume the current turn's orb-switches, allowing the Starmon to continue moving orbs as if no skill was used in this step.

skill2.name: Tactical Decoy
skill2.description: Gain a shield equal to 220% of its current ATK (This shield does not expire and can only be broken via taking DMG).

passive.name: Kinetic Battery
passive.description: Cyborgnid's internal reactor absorbs energy from incoming impact. It gains 10 Mana every time it takes damage from an enemy attack or ability.

skill1.name: Plasma Slash
skill1.description: Slashes the target with steel claws, dealing 130% Steel DMG.

skill2.name: Charge Beam
skill2.description: Gains a Shield equal to 20% its max HP for 3 turns to absorb energy from attacks and unleashes laser blast dealing Steel DMG equal to 30% DMG it taken.
skill2.statusEffect: 20% Max HP Shield (3 turns) & Absorbed Blast

passive.name: Proximity Detonation
passive.description: When hit by an attack or ability, Mineacle automatically counters with a burst of water pressure, reflecting 20% of the damage back to the attacker. Upon death, it explodes and deals DMG equal to 10% of its max HP to all enemies.

skill1.name: Chain Slam
skill1.description: Swings its heavy spiked chain to smash the target, dealing 170% Water DMG.

skill2.name: Iron Barricade
skill2.description: Gain Taunt effect and a 50% max HP Shield for 3 turns.
skill2.statusEffect: Taunt (3 turns) & 50% Max HP Shield (3 turns)

passive.name: Order Crown
passive.description: Gives 10% DMG boost to all Wind Attacks & Abilities from Zephyrion & its allies and gains Clarity (Immune to Burn, Stun, Taunt, Frost Bite, Poison)

skill1.name: Justice Judgment
skill1.description: Deals 125% Wind DMG to the target. If the target has more HP than the user, double the DMG.
skill1.statusEffect: 125% Wind DMG (250% if Target HP > User HP)

skill2.name: Righteous Gale
skill2.description: If any target has at least 1 debuff currently active before the user activates this ability, that target takes double the DMG from this ability. Deals 120% AoE Wind DMG to all enemies and removes all the buff and debuff statuses from all enemies.
skill2.statusEffect: 120% AoE Wind DMG (Double if Debuffed) & Dispel All

passive.name: Mossy Camouflage
passive.description: While Mossloth is below 50% max HP, it has a 20% chance to dodge any basic attack or single-target skill that targets it.

skill1.name: Branch Slam
skill1.description: Deals Earth DMG based on the user's max HP (15%).

skill2.name: Sluggish Metabolism
skill2.description: Mossloth stays still to slow down its metabolism. Gain Taunt for 3 turns and heal 15% of its max HP at the end of every turn.
skill2.statusEffect: Taunt (3 turns) & Regen 15% Max HP/turn (3 turns)

passive.name: Desert Shroud
passive.description: After using an ability, the user gains 30% Evasiveness for 1 turn. Evasiveness does not stack.

skill1.name: Mummy's Curse
skill1.description: Puts a curse on the target, dealing Earth DMG equal to 10% of target's current HP and applying Healing Block for 2 turns (prevent HP regeneration from all sources).
skill1.statusEffect: 10% Target Current HP DMG & Healing Block (2 turns)

skill2.name: Ritual of the Sun
skill2.description: Summon the Sun Effect on the entire board for 3 turns. When Sun is active, all Water DMG is reduced by 20% and all Fire DMG increases by 20%. When the sun effect is active, Khepri's ATK increases by 20% and Desert Shroud passive is also activated.
skill2.statusEffect: Sun Field (3 turns): Fire +20%, Water -20%, Khepri ATK +20%, Desert Shroud activated

passive.name: Carapace Wall
passive.description: When Coralus's HP is above 50%, reduces all incoming damage by 15% for itself and all allies.

skill1.name: Aqua Pincer
skill1.description: Crushes target with twin water-infused claws dealing 180% DMG and reducing enemy DEF by 25% for 2 turns.

skill2.name: Bubble Fortress
skill2.description: Creates a durable water barrier absorbing damage for the entire party lasting for 3 turns.

passive.name: Wildfire
passive.description: Attacks have a 35% chance to ignite enemies with Burn, dealing damage each round.

skill1.name: Flame Burst
skill1.description: Hurls an explosive fireball dealing 200% Fire DMG. Deals 350% DMG if target is Burned!

skill2.name: Inferno Eruption
skill2.description: Summons a raging vortex of foxfire hitting ALL enemies for 180% AoE Fire DMG.

passive.name: Enraged
passive.description: Gains +30% Base ATK bonus whenever Current HP drops below 50%.

skill1.name: Fire Claw
skill1.description: Executes a furious double strike, slashing the enemy twice for 85% ATK each.

skill2.name: Magma Impact
skill2.description: Slams molten magma onto the foe dealing 240% Fire DMG with guaranteed 30% Burn.

passive.name: Fluid Precision
passive.description: Basic Match-3 attacks recover 10% of Tidecrush Max HP as ocean tide vitality. If Tidecrush HP is full, gains 10 extra mana instead.

skill1.name: Frost Slash
skill1.description: Slices through enemy armor with dual frozen daggers dealing 175% Water DMG.

skill2.name: Tidal Surge
skill2.description: Converts all current Mana into bonus Attack stat (1 Mana = +0.2% Base ATK) lasting 3 turns with a 3-turn cooldown. Deals 0 direct damage!

passive.name: Wind Battery
passive.description: Gain 2 mana for every Wind or Electric orb consumed by either side.

skill1.name: Plasma Ray
skill1.description: Fires a concentrated beam of static electricity for 180% DMG and applies Silence.

skill2.name: Giga-Watt Explosion
skill2.description: Unleashes an overwhelming storm shockwave dealing 320% AoE Electric DMG with 1-turn Stun, sacrificing 30% of Glidron’s current HP.

passive.name: Static Surge
passive.description: Voltlynx attacks have +25% extra Critical Chance, and Voltlynx's critical attacks & abilities deal an extra 25% DMG.

skill1.name: Lightning Paw
skill1.description: Strikes with lightning agility dealing 110% Electric DMG with +25% bonus Critical Chance.

skill2.name: Thunder Bolt
skill2.description: Calls down 3 erratic lightning bolts hitting random enemies for 120% DMG each (each bolt randomly selects a target).

passive.name: Shatter Strike
passive.description: Ancient runes empower all physical and skill hits with +30% inherent Critical Chance.

skill1.name: Stone Crash
skill1.description: Gain Piercing for 2 turns, ignoring 50% of target DEF and still able to move this turn.

skill2.name: Tectonic Cleave
skill2.description: Ruptures the earth beneath opposing frontlines dealing a devastating 280% Earth DMG.

passive.name: Unyielding Granite
passive.description: Gains a Shield equal to 5% of max HP at the start of each round. Upon death, gives all allies a Shield equal to 25% of Stone Golem's max HP for 3 turns.

skill1.name: Stone Crash
skill1.description: Deals 120% Earth Physical Damage to a target enemy and has 30% chance to stun the Target.

skill2.name: Fortress Bulwark
skill2.description: Taunts all enemies for 2 turns, forcing them to target Stone Golem with single-target attacks and abilities. Instantly grants itself a Shield equal to 18% of its Max HP for 2 turns.

starmons.name: Aquanymph Đa Phúc
starmons.title: Phiên Bản Độc Quyền Đa Phúc

passive.name: Dewdrop Bloom
passive.description: Restores 8% Max HP to lowest ally each turn.

skill1.name: Hydro Cyclone
skill1.description: Deals 180% Water DMG and has 20% to give Frostbite to the target for 3 turns. If the target already has Frostbite, silent them for 1 turns.

skill2.name: Lotus Rain
skill2.description: Restores 160 HP to all allies and cleanses debuffs.

passive.name: Overclock Battery
passive.description: Charges +5 extra Mana whenever an Electric match is made.

skill1.name: Spark Matrix
skill1.description: Empowers team with +25% ATK for 2 rounds.

skill2.name: EMP Discharge
skill2.description: Blasts enemies with 210% AoE Electric & Metal DMG.

passive.name: Magma Shell
passive.description: Reflects 20% of incoming physical damage back as Fire Burn.

skill1.name: Lava Spurt
skill1.description: Shoots burning lava dealing 150% Fire DMG.

skill2.name: Volcanic Eruption
skill2.description: Rains molten slag and metallic debris dealing 230% AoE Fire & Steel damage.

passive.name: Absolute Zero
passive.description: Allies' Water and Wind skills have a 10% chance to give Frostbite (Reduce their Attack by 10%) to the enemies for 1 turn.

skill1.name: Crystal Scales
skill1.description: Scatters razor frost dealing 170% Wind DMG.

skill2.name: Blizzard Tempest
skill2.description: Summons a freezing blizzard tempest dealing 180% AoE Wind DMG.

passive.name: Static Feather
passive.description: Zapwing gains +10% ATK every time it takes damage from an attack or ability.

skill1.name: Lightning Beak
skill1.description: Zapwing coats its beak in concentrated electricity and dives into a single target, dealing 135% Electric Damage. Has a 35% chance to inflict stun to the target.

skill2.name: Thunder Gale Tempest
skill2.description: Flaps its wings rapidly to create a swirling storm of crackling lightning and gusting winds, dealing 220% Electric Damage to all enemies.

passive.name: Toxic Spore
passive.description: Whenever Vinedra executes an attack triggered by Earth orbs or casts an Active Skill, has a 35% chance to inflict Poison on the targeted enemy for 2 turns (DEF reduced by 10%, takes 5% max HP damage after its turn).

skill1.name: Thorn Whip
skill1.description: Vinedra lashes out with its thorny tail, dealing 70% Earth Damage. Gains +20% critical chance for attacks and abilities. If Vinedra has 25 or more mana remaining, it can use Thorn Whip again this turn!

skill2.name: Poisonous Burst
skill2.description: Opens the purple floral bulb on its tail to release a toxic cloud across the enemy side, dealing 85% Earth Damage to all foes with a 35% chance to poison each enemy.

passive.name: Tidal Momentum
passive.description: Gain a permanent Resonance effect. Bubbleboon doesn't lose a turn when using its abilities.
passive.effectDetail: Grants the Starmon an immediate continuation of action. Using an active ability does not consume the current turn's orb-switches, allowing the Starmon to continue moving orbs as if no skill was used in this step.

skill1.name: Double Jet Punch
skill1.description: Gain Double Strike for 1 turn. Bubbleboon performs consecutive orb switches instead of 1.

skill2.name: Bubble Bomb
skill2.description: Deals 180% Water Physical DMG to the target and converts 3 random non-water orbs into Water Orbs. If this conversion inadvertently triggers a chain of 3 or more connected Water orbs, it inflicts an additional burst of DMG equal to 100% Atk.

passive.name: Infiltration Strike
passive.description: Trojan Flare gains an additional 10% ATK (calculated from its base ATK) and Piercing whenever a Shield is currently active on it. This attack bonus immediately disappears when the shield expires or is broken.

skill1.name: Siege Charge
skill1.description: Gain Clarity (Immune to stun, froze bite, burn, poison) and Resonance effect for 1 turn (Resonance is applied in the next turn, not this).
skill1.effectDetail: Grants the Starmon an immediate continuation of action. Using an active ability does not consume the current turn's orb-switches, allowing the Starmon to continue moving orbs as if no skill was used in this step.

skill2.name: Tactical Decoy
skill2.description: Gain a shield equal to 220% of its current ATK (This shield does not expire and can only be broken via taking DMG).

passive.name: Kinetic Battery
passive.description: Cyborgnid's internal reactor absorbs energy from incoming impact. It gains 10 Mana every time it takes damage from an enemy attack or ability.

skill1.name: Plasma Slash
skill1.description: Slashes the target with steel claws, dealing 130% Steel DMG.

skill2.name: Charge Beam
skill2.description: Gains a Shield equal to 20% its max HP for 3 turns to absorb energy from attacks and unleashes laser blast dealing Steel DMG equal to 30% DMG it taken.
skill2.statusEffect: 20% Max HP Shield (3 turns) & Absorbed Blast

passive.name: Proximity Detonation
passive.description: When hit by an attack or ability, Mineacle automatically counters with a burst of water pressure, reflecting 20% of the damage back to the attacker. Upon death, it explodes and deals DMG equal to 10% of its max HP to all enemies.

skill1.name: Chain Slam
skill1.description: Swings its heavy spiked chain to smash the target, dealing 170% Water DMG.

skill2.name: Iron Barricade
skill2.description: Gain Taunt effect and a 50% max HP Shield for 3 turns.
skill2.statusEffect: Taunt (3 turns) & 50% Max HP Shield (3 turns)

passive.name: Order Crown
passive.description: Gives 10% DMG boost to all Wind Attacks & Abilities from Zephyrion & its allies and gains Clarity (Immune to Burn, Stun, Taunt, Frost Bite, Poison)

skill1.name: Justice Judgment
skill1.description: Deals 125% Wind DMG to the target. If the target has more HP than the user, double the DMG.
skill1.statusEffect: 125% Wind DMG (250% if Target HP > User HP)

skill2.name: Righteous Gale
skill2.description: If any target has at least 1 debuff currently active before the user activates this ability, that target takes double the DMG from this ability. Deals 120% AoE Wind DMG to all enemies and removes all the buff and debuff statuses from all enemies.
skill2.statusEffect: 120% AoE Wind DMG (Double if Debuffed) & Dispel All

passive.name: Mossy Camouflage
passive.description: While Mossloth is below 50% max HP, it has a 20% chance to dodge any basic attack or single-target skill that targets it.

skill1.name: Branch Slam
skill1.description: Deals Earth DMG based on the user's max HP (15%).

skill2.name: Sluggish Metabolism
skill2.description: Mossloth stays still to slow down its metabolism. Gain Taunt for 3 turns and heal 15% of its max HP at the end of every turn.
skill2.statusEffect: Taunt (3 turns) & Regen 15% Max HP/turn (3 turns)

passive.name: Desert Shroud
passive.description: After using an ability, the user gains 30% Evasiveness for 1 turn. Evasiveness does not stack.

skill1.name: Mummy's Curse
skill1.description: Puts a curse on the target, dealing Earth DMG equal to 10% of target's current HP and applying Healing Block for 2 turns (prevent HP regeneration from all sources).
skill1.statusEffect: 10% Target Current HP DMG & Healing Block (2 turns)

skill2.name: Ritual of the Sun
skill2.description: Summon the Sun Effect on the entire board for 3 turns. When Sun is active, all Water DMG is reduced by 20% and all Fire DMG increases by 20%. When the sun effect is active, Khepri's ATK increases by 20% and Desert Shroud passive is also activated.
skill2.statusEffect: Sun Field (3 turns): Fire +20%, Water -20%, Khepri ATK +20%, Desert Shroud activated

skill1.effectDetail: Grants the Starmon an immediate continuation of action. Using an active ability does not consume the current turn's orb-switches, allowing the Starmon to continue moving orbs as if no skill was used in this step.

skill2.name: Tactical Decoy
skill2.description: Gain a shield equal to 220% of its current ATK (This shield does not expire and can only be broken via taking DMG).

passive.name: Kinetic Battery
passive.description: Cyborgnid's internal reactor absorbs energy from incoming impact. It gains 10 Mana every time it takes damage from an enemy attack or ability.

skill1.name: Plasma Slash
skill1.description: Slashes the target with steel claws, dealing 130% Steel DMG.

skill2.name: Charge Beam
skill2.description: Gains a Shield equal to 20% its max HP for 3 turns to absorb energy from attacks and unleashes laser blast dealing Steel DMG equal to 30% DMG it taken.
skill2.statusEffect: 20% Max HP Shield (3 turns) & Absorbed Blast

passive.name: Proximity Detonation
passive.description: When hit by an attack or ability, Mineacle automatically counters with a burst of water pressure, reflecting 20% of the damage back to the attacker. Upon death, it explodes and deals DMG equal to 10% of its max HP to all enemies.

skill1.name: Chain Slam
skill1.description: Swings its heavy spiked chain to smash the target, dealing 170% Water DMG.

skill2.name: Iron Barricade
skill2.description: Gain Taunt effect and a 50% max HP Shield for 3 turns.
skill2.statusEffect: Taunt (3 turns) & 50% Max HP Shield (3 turns)

passive.name: Order Crown
passive.description: Gives 10% DMG boost to all Wind Attacks & Abilities from Zephyrion & its allies and gains Clarity (Immune to Burn, Stun, Taunt, Frost Bite, Poison)

skill1.name: Justice Judgment
skill1.description: Deals 125% Wind DMG to the target. If the target has more HP than the user, double the DMG.
skill1.statusEffect: 125% Wind DMG (250% if Target HP > User HP)

skill2.name: Righteous Gale
skill2.description: If any target has at least 1 debuff currently active before the user activates this ability, that target takes double the DMG from this ability. Deals 120% AoE Wind DMG to all enemies and removes all the buff and debuff statuses from all enemies.
skill2.statusEffect: 120% AoE Wind DMG (Double if Debuffed) & Dispel All

passive.name: Mossy Camouflage
passive.description: While Mossloth is below 50% max HP, it has a 20% chance to dodge any basic attack or single-target skill that targets it.

skill1.name: Branch Slam
skill1.description: Deals Earth DMG based on the user's max HP (15%).

skill2.name: Sluggish Metabolism
skill2.description: Mossloth stays still to slow down its metabolism. Gain Taunt for 3 turns and heal 15% of its max HP at the end of every turn.
skill2.statusEffect: Taunt (3 turns) & Regen 15% Max HP/turn (3 turns)

passive.name: Desert Shroud
passive.description: After using an ability, the user gains 30% Evasiveness for 1 turn. Evasiveness does not stack.

skill1.name: Mummy's Curse
skill1.description: Puts a curse on the target, dealing Earth DMG equal to 10% of target's current HP and applying Healing Block for 2 turns (prevent HP regeneration from all sources).
skill1.statusEffect: 10% Target Current HP DMG & Healing Block (2 turns)

skill2.name: Ritual of the Sun
skill2.description: Summon the Sun Effect on the entire board for 3 turns. When Sun is active, all Water DMG is reduced by 20% and all Fire DMG increases by 20%. When the sun effect is active, Khepri's ATK increases by 20% and Desert Shroud passive is also activated.
skill2.statusEffect: Sun Field (3 turns): Fire +20%, Water -20%, Khepri ATK +20%, Desert Shroud activated
